source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of parallel-plate capacitors (PDF 68-71).

blocks.text: Parallel-plate capacitor do conductors par mushtamil hai jo qareeb rakhe hon aur khala, hawa ya kisi aur insulator, jise dielectric kehte hain, se juda hon. Jab plates V voltage ki battery se jori jayein (Fig 16.6) to battery apne musbat terminal se juri plate par +Q aur doosri par -Q charge dalti hai, aur un ke darmiyan potential difference V banta hai. Dekha gaya hai ke Q, V ke mutanasib hai, is liye Q = CV, ya C = Q/V (16.28). Constant C capacitor ki capacitance hai; yeh plates ki banawat aur un ke darmiyan medium par munhasir hai, aur capacitor ki charge jama karne ki salahiyat napti hai.

blocks.title: Capacitance; farad
blocks.text: Capacitor ki capacitance aik plate par woh charge hai jo doosri plate ke muqable us ka potential aik volt barhaye. Is ki SI ikai coulomb fi volt hai, jise Michael Faraday ke naam par farad (F) kehte hain: capacitor ki capacitance aik farad hai agar aik plate ko diya gaya aik coulomb plates ke darmiyan aik volt potential difference paida kare.

Do mutawazi dhaat ki plates lein, har aik ka raqba A, chhote faasle d par, taake un ke darmiyan field E yaksan aur taqreeban poori tarah darmiyani ilaqe tak mehdood ho, aur darmiyan hawa ya khala ho. Phir Cvac = Q/V (16.29) aur E = V/d (16.30). Gauss ke qanoon se plates ke darmiyan field E = sigma/eo hai, jahan sigma = Q/A satah ki charge density hai, is liye E = Q/(A eo) (16.31). Barabar karne par V/d = Q/(A eo), jis se Cvac = Q/V = A eo / d (16.32).

blocks.alt: Tirchi bani do mutawazi plates, baen peeli +Q aur daen neeli -Q, d faasle par, har aik ka raqba A. Taarein unhein switch S ke zariye V voltage ki battery se jorti. Notes: Q, V ke mutanasib, Q = CV, C = Q/V; SI ikai farad = C/V; Cvac = A eo / d aur Cmed = A eo er / d.
blocks.caption: Parallel-plate capacitor (Fig 16.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Bari plates usi voltage par zyada charge rakhti hain, aur qareeb plates usi charge par taqatwar field banati hain, is liye C = A eo / d, A ke saath barhta aur d ke saath ghatta hai.

blocks.text: Agar plates ke darmiyan er relative permittivity ka insulating maddah (dielectric) rakha jaye to capacitance er guna barh jati hai; er ko dielectric constant bhi kehte hain. Ise dekhne ke liye charged capacitor ko voltmeter se joren (Fig 16.7 a): sui ka jhukao potential difference napta hai. Dielectric dalne par reading gir jati hai (Fig 16.7 b). Kyunke C = Q/V aur Q wahi rehta jab ke V girta hai, C barhti hai: Cmed = A eo er / d (16.33). Equation 16.32 se taqseem karne par er = Cmed / Cvac (16.34).

blocks.title: Dielectric constant
blocks.text: Dielectric constant parallel-plate capacitor ki capacitance, jab plates ke darmiyan insulating maddah ho, aur khala (ya hawa) ke saath us ki capacitance ka tanasub hai.

Potential difference is liye girta hai ke dielectric ke atoms polarise ho jate hain. Dielectric insulator hai: is mein azad electrons nahi, aur tamam electrons apne nuclei se bandhe hain. Electric field mein har atom ke electrons field ke ulat thora khisak jate hain (Fig 16.7 c); atom polarised kehlata hai. Mukhalif charge wali plates ke darmiyan slab mein tamam atoms polarised ho jate hain (Fig 16.7 d), aur slab ki plates se chhooti satahon par charges nazar aate hain jo saath wali plate ke charge ke ulat nishan ke hain. Yeh plates ke charges ka asar jazwi taur par khatam karte hain, is liye plates ke darmiyan field aur potential difference ghatte hain.

blocks.alt: Baen: (a) plates ke darmiyan hawa wala charged capacitor voltmeter se jura, reading Vo; (b) wahi capacitor plates ke darmiyan sabz dielectric slab ke saath; voltmeter ab kam V parhta. Daen: field ke baghair atom, nucleus electron badal ke markaz mein; daen field mein electron badal baen khisakta; neeche musbat aur manfi plate ke darmiyan polarised atoms se bhara slab, har aik ka manfi rukh musbat plate ki taraf.
blocks.caption: Plates ke darmiyan dielectric (Fig 16.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Slab dalne par plates ka charge nahi badalta, lekin polarised slab andar field kamzor karta hai, is liye voltage girta aur C = Q/V, er guna barhti hai.

blocks.prompt: Parallel-plate capacitor ki plates ka raqba 0.02 m^2 aur hawa mein faasla 1.0 mm hai. Is ki capacitance, aur er = 5 wale dielectric ke saath capacitance maloom karein.

items: Q = CV; C plates ke raqbe, faasle aur medium par munhasir.
Cvac = A eo / d; Cmed = A eo er / d; er = Cmed/Cvac.
Dielectric polarise ho kar field kamzor karta, V girta aur C barhti.
